name: KIC 11802109
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 10.4 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11802109 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 10.4147 +/- 0.184

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11802109 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 0.9293 +/- 0.036

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11802109 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4776.2583 +/- 44.9868

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11802109 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.3737 +/- 0.0038

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 0.93 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,776 K at its surface.
